children: Iranian forces have recently shot down at least two American MQ-1 unmanned aircraft, CBS reported Thursday, citing U.S. officials familiar with the matter.

The specific location of the downings and the exact MQ-1 variant involved remain unknown. The U.S. military relies on two primary versions of the aircraft: the older, largely retired Air Force Predator and the Army’s actively deployed Gray Eagle.

While typically utilized for intelligence and reconnaissance—such as tracking Iranian military movements and monitoring the Strait of Hormuz—both drone models can be equipped with Hellfire missiles for strike missions, CBS noted.
